subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: Should OpenClaw preserve the full `systemPromptReport` per session, persist only the warning-dedupe subset, or move report data out of `sessions.json` entirely?
rationale: Current source and tests make `systemPromptReport` load-bearing for warning dedupe, while issue evidence shows the full report can dominate large stores; automation should not choose that storage contract alone.

options.title: Persist only dedupe state
options.body: Store `bootstrapTruncation.warningSignaturesSeen` durably and stop persisting bulky tools, skills, and workspace report sections per session.

options.title: Compact stale reports
options.body: Keep full reports only for active or recent sessions and strip or summarize them during session maintenance for stale entries.

options.title: Move reports to a new store
options.body: Design a canonical non-`sessions.json` store for context-weight/report details and migrate consumers such as the usage API to it.

recommendation.title: Persist only dedupe state
recommendation.body: Store `bootstrapTruncation.warningSignaturesSeen` durably and stop persisting bulky tools, skills, and workspace report sections per session.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged prompt-dedupe PR is the closest current-main feature-history signal for this session storage boundary.
